title.zh: 确保多语言词汇跟读始终可继续

purpose.en: Repair the stuck model-audio and microphone states discovered by signed-in Japanese vocabulary testing so learners can always continue or skip.
purpose.zh: 修复真实账号日语词汇测试发现的示范音频与麦克风卡死状态，确保学习者始终可以继续或跳过。

en: Bound every vocabulary model-audio turn with a language-aware watchdog.
Recover automatically when speech recognition ends without a transcript.
Restore both Continue and Skip controls after microphone or speech-engine failures.
zh: 为每次词汇示范朗读增加按词长限制的超时保护。
语音识别结束但没有返回文字时自动恢复操作状态。
麦克风或系统语音失败后重新开放“继续跟读”和“跳过本词”。

en: Cancel a stalled speech-synthesis utterance and advance to microphone listening after a bounded delay.
Handle recognition error, empty end, start failure, and a twelve-second no-result timeout through one recovery path.
Keep the recovery message explicit and leave Skip available instead of trapping the learner.
zh: 示范朗读超过限定时间时取消卡住的语音，并继续进入麦克风监听。
将识别错误、空结束、启动失败和十二秒无结果统一导向可恢复状态。
恢复提示明确说明麦克风权限与跳过选项，不再把学习者锁在禁用按钮上。

en: The signed-in Chinese-interface test learner reproduced the Japanese vocabulary lock before the fix.
Regression contracts cover synthesis timeout, recognition timeout, empty recognition end, and the visible skip recovery message.
TypeScript, sensitive-data scan, and all 307 repository tests pass before deployment.
zh: 中文界面真实测试账号已在修复前复现日语词汇跟读锁死。
回归契约覆盖朗读超时、识别超时、无结果结束和可见跳过恢复提示。
发布前 TypeScript、敏感数据扫描和仓库全部 307 项测试均已通过。

en: Automated speech scoring remains dependent on a real audio input; unavailable test-runner audio is reported as capability-limited, never passed.
zh: 自动发音评分仍依赖真实音频输入；测试运行器没有音频输入时标记为能力受限，绝不误报通过。

en: This recovery is specific to SmartLingo vocabulary pronunciation practice and does not alter other portfolio sites.
zh: 本次恢复仅针对 SmartLingo 词汇发音练习，不改变其他站点。
